notes.title: QualityScaler 2.5
notes.content:
NEW

 Added 2 new RRDB AI models ( BSRGANx2, RealESRGANx4 )
 Added 2 new SRVGGNetCompact AI models  SRVGGNetCompact (RealESR_Gx4, RealSRx4_Anime)
 Removed older RRDB AI models with lower upscale quality

GUI

 The app will now report the remaining time to complete video upscaling
 The app now reports the progress in % instead of the number of frames
 Updated info texts

BUGFIXES / IMPROVEMENTS

 Drastically reduced CPU utilization by 90% without impacting upscale speed
 Updated dependencies
 General code cleaning and improvements
